reason: Net-additive defect fix (task 6133): stack_train_branches now un-stacks the train ANCHOR from an earlier unlanded stack base before stacking successors onto it, and abandons formation when it cannot (BLOCKED/CONFLICT), so a coalesce/former train anchored on a member still carrying a never-landed predecessor's commits can no longer land that predecessor's deliverable through _do_train_merge. The un-stack-and-log policy is extracted from _stack_member into GitOps._shed_unlanded_base so both paths share it. Not a refactor that failed.
